_comment: Corrections to the parsed C09066 suggested sequences, in the same auditable form
as data_overrides.json on the USYD side: every change records what it changes,
why, and the source it was checked against. Nothing here is applied silently.
These exist because the course-page PDF the sequences were parsed from is no
longer on disk, so parse_uts_sequences.py cannot simply be re-run. The parser
itself has been fixed for future runs; these entries bring the already-parsed
uts_sequences.json into line in the meantime. Re-running the parser against a
regenerated c09066.txt makes them redundant, which apply_sequence_overrides
reports as 'already correct' rather than treating as an error.

moves.name: Environmental Planning and Law
moves.reason: The course page lists 48850 under Year 3 December session. The session-heading pattern in parse_uts_sequences.py matched only Autumn, Spring and Summer, so the December heading did not register and the preceding Spring heading stayed in force. This put Civil and Environmental at 30cp in Year 3 Spring against 21cp in Year 4 Autumn, where every other major sits at 24 or 27. It also gave 48850 a wrong inferred availability, since 48850 is one of the nine subjects with no published availability and its session was inferred from this very placement.
moves.verified_by: Course page read directly on 2026-10-22, which prints Year 3 Spring as 41203, 48330, 48353, 41028 and one 6cp choice group, with 48850 under Year 3 December session.
moves.parser_fix: parse_uts_sequences.py now accepts any '<Name> session' heading and reports session names it cannot map to a position.
